title: Qwen3.8 27B Q6_K on two RTX 5060 Ti 16GB cards
purpose: Recommended dual-card Qwen3.8 route, validated at 131K with Q6_K, f16 KV, and tensor split 50,50.
caveats: Validated for uncached retrieval at ~115.4K prompt tokens and sustained visible generation at ~91.8K prompt tokens.
Qwen3.8 is thinking-heavy; the profile allows 3,072 sustained output tokens while keeping a separate 1,076-token minimum generated-work threshold.
The single-card IQ3_XXS 64K q8 route remains the recommended one-card Qwen3.8 preset; this Q6_K route is the dual-card recommendation.
131K is the highest tier tested here, not a maximum-context claim.
